text: Before the light reaches the hill, the cherries are already red.
My grandmother planted these rows in nineteen seventy-one.
asr: My grandmother planted these rows in 1971.

text: At seventeen hundred metres, coffee ripens slowly. That is the whole secret.
asr: At 1700 meters, coffee ripens slowly. That is the whole secret.

text: We pick only what is red. The rest waits for another morning.
asr: We pick only what is read. The rest waits for another morning.

text: By seven, four baskets. By noon, the mill will have all of it.
Water, then skins, then the beans. The cherry gives up everything.
The beds face east, so the sun works first.
By afternoon the patio smells like bread and wet stone.
And then, one cup. This one is ours.
